description: Figure 4.1 contains five line plots arranged in a grid, illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of different-sized Whisper models (tiny, base, medium, large) under various weight quantization and adaptation strategies. Each plot shares the same x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranging from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks, and a y-axis labeled “WER,” with scale and range varying per subplot. The first plot (top-left, “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny”) shows five lines: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (gray solid line with square markers), “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (gray dashed line with square markers), “tiny int4” (gray solid line with circle markers), “tiny int8” (gray dashed line with circle markers), and “tiny full” (gray dotted line with triangle markers). All lines start at high WER (60–70) at epoch 0 and generally decline over epochs, with “tiny full” consistently lowest (starting ~29, ending ~24) and “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” highest (starting ~69, ending ~40). The second plot (top-right, “type = base”) uses blue lines: “base AdaLoRA_int4” (solid square), “base AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed square), “base int4” (solid circle), “base int8” (dashed circle), and “base full” (dotted triangle). WER starts around 58–60 and declines; “base full” remains lowest (starting ~22, ending ~19), while others end between 34–40. The third plot (middle-right, “type = medium”) uses green lines: “medium AdaLoRA_int4” (solid square), “medium AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed square), “medium int4” (solid circle), and “medium int8” (dashed circle). WER starts around 25–30; “medium int4” peaks at epoch 1 (~36) then declines, while “medium AdaLoRA_int4” drops steadily to ~12 at epoch 6. The fourth plot (bottom, “type = large”) uses purple lines: “large AdaLoRA_int4” (solid square), “large AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed square), “large int4” (solid circle), and “large int8” (dashed circle). WER starts around 24–26; “large int4” peaks at epoch 2 (~32) then falls to ~13, while “large AdaLoRA_int4” declines steadily to ~10. The fifth subplot (middle-left) is blank gray and contains no data. The overall caption reads: “Figure 4.1: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights.”
